snippet.title: Lufia V: For the Savior (Fangame) - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
"LUFIA", ALL CHARACTERS, GRAPHICS, SOUND, ETC COPYRIGHT SQUARE ENIX.
THIS IS A NON-PROFIT FAN MADE PROJECT, WITH NO RELATION TO ANY AFFILIATED
PARTIES SUCH AS NEVERLAND CO, TAITO, NATSUME OR ATLUS.

Download: https://dekar-the-great.itch.io/lufiav

A non-profit fan-made sequel to the critically acclaimed "Lufia" series, twenty years in the making. Puzzles, battles, and more! Experience the heartfelt fan-made conclusion to the Lufian legend! 

• 30+ hours of gameplay 
• 25+ dungeons to explore 
• 20+ towns bustling with people 
• 100+ interactive puzzles 
• 100+ unique spells/abilities 
• Dozens of boss fights and over 100 different encounters

More Info
https://www.facebook.com/lufiav
https://discord.gg/3BJwxJ8KaN

Meet the dev!
https://cambowman.wixsite.com/portfolio
https://www.linkedin.com/in/cameron-bowman/
